mapper.select: SELECT SCHDUL_ID AS schdul_id, SCHDUL_NM AS schdul_nm, SCHDUL_BGNDE AS schdul_bgnde, SCHDUL_ENDDE AS schdul_endde, SCHDUL_PLACE AS schdul_place, SCHDUL_KND_CODE AS schdul_knd_code FROM COMTNSCHDULINFO WHERE SUBSTRING(SCHDUL_BGNDE, 1, 8) = #{today} AND (TRIM(SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID) = #{uniqId}) ORDER BY SCHDUL_BGNDE LIMIT 10

SELECT a.NTT_ID AS ntt_id, a.BBS_ID AS bbs_id, a.NTT_SJ AS ntt_sj, a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AS frst_regist_pnttm, b.BBS_NM AS bbs_nm FROM COMTNBBS a JOIN COMTNBBSMASTER b ON a.BBS_ID = b.BBS_ID WHERE a.USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM COMTNNOTERECPTN WHERE TRIM(RCVER_ID) = #{value} AND OPEN_YN = 'N'

SELECT a.NTT_ID AS ntt_id, a.BBS_ID AS bbs_id, a.NTT_SJ AS ntt_sj, a.NTT_CN AS ntt_cn, a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AS frst_regist_pnttm FROM COMTNBBS a WHERE a.BBS_ID = 'BBSMSTR_000000000001' AND a.USE_AT = 'Y' AND a.NOTICE_AT = 'Y' AND (a.NTCE_BGNDE IS NULL OR a.NTCE_BGNDE <= #{value}) AND (a.NTCE_ENDDE IS NULL OR a.NTCE_ENDDE >= #{value}) ORDER BY a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC LIMIT 5
